alterClaimer(uint256,address).details: The new claimer may not be the zero address. The message sender must be the owner of the deposit.

params._depositId: Unique identifier of the deposit which will have its claimer altered.

alterDelegatee(uint256,address).details: The new delegatee may not be the zero address. The message sender must be the owner of the deposit.

params._depositId: Unique identifier of the deposit which will have its delegatee altered.
params._newDelegatee: Address of the new governance delegate.

params._depositId: The identifier for the deposit that needs an updated earning power.
params._requestedTip: The amount of tip requested by the third-party.
params._tipReceiver: The receiver of the reward for updating a deposit's earning power.

params._depositId: Identifier of the deposit from which accrued rewards will be claimed.

returns._0: Amount of reward tokens claimed, after the fee has been assessed.

params._maxBumpTip: Maximum tip a bumper may request (0 — bumping disabled in Phase 1).
params._token: ZEN token address (used as both reward and stake token — ZEN-on-ZEN staking).

params._depositIds: All deposit IDs belonging to this depositor.

getDepositorSummary(address).details: Does not aggregate unclaimed rewards across deposits — deposit IDs are tracked by the indexer, not on-chain. Use getDepositorFullSummary with the IDs from the indexer for reward totals.

params._depositIds: List of deposit identifiers to query.

returns._0: Timestamp representing the last time at which rewards have been distributed.

multicall(bytes[]).details: Receives and executes a batch of function calls on this contract.

permitAndStake(uint256,address,address,u.details: Neither the delegatee nor the claimer may be the zero address. The deposit will be owned by the message sender.

params._amount: Quantity of the staking token to stake.
params._claimer: Address that will have the right to claim rewards for this stake.
params._deadline: The timestamp after which the permit signature should expire.
params._delegatee: Address to assign the governance voting weight of the staked tokens.
params._s: ECDSA signature component: `s` value of the signature
params._v: ECDSA signature component: Parity of the `y` coordinate of point `R`

permitAndStakeMore(uint256,uint256,uint2.details: The message sender must be the owner of the deposit.

params._amount: Quantity of stake to be added.
params._deadline: The timestamp after which the permit signature should expire.
params._depositId: Unique identifier of the deposit to which stake will be added.
params._s: ECDSA signature component: `s` value of the signature
params._v: ECDSA signature component: Parity of the `y` coordinate of point `R`

returns._0: Live value of the global reward per token accumulator.

setAdmin(address).details: Caller must be the current admin.

setMaxBumpTip(uint256).details: Caller must be the current admin.

params._newMaxBumpTip: Value of the new max bump tip.

setRewardNotifier(address,bool).details: Caller must be the current admin.

params._isEnabled: `true` to enable the `_rewardNotifier`, or `false` to disable.

stake(uint256,address).details: The delegatee may not be the zero address. The deposit will be owned by the message sender, and the claimer will also be the message sender.

params._amount: The amount of the staking token to stake.
params._delegatee: The address to assign the governance voting weight of the staked tokens.

returns._depositId: The unique identifier for this deposit.

stake(uint256,address,address).details: Neither the delegatee nor the claimer may be the zero address. The deposit will be owned by the message sender.

params._amount: Quantity of the staking token to stake.
params._claimer: Address that will have the right to claim rewards for this stake.
params._delegatee: Address to assign the governance voting weight of the staked tokens.

stakeMore(uint256,uint256).details: The message sender must be the owner of the deposit.

params._amount: Quantity of stake to be added.
params._depositId: Unique identifier of the deposit to which stake will be added.

surrogates(address).details: A concrete implementation should return a delegate surrogate address for a given delegatee. In practice this may be as simple as returning an address stored in a mapping or computing its create2 address.

params._delegatee: The address to which the delegation surrogate is delegating voting power.

params._depositId: Identifier of the deposit in question.

returns._0: Live value of the unclaimed rewards earned by a given deposit.

withdraw(uint256,uint256).details: The message sender must be the owner of the deposit. Stake is withdrawn to the message sender's account.

params._amount: Quantity of staked token to withdraw.
params._depositId: Unique identifier of the deposit from which stake will be withdrawn.

MAX_CLAIM_FEE().notice: The maximum value to which the claim fee can be set.

REWARD_DURATION().notice: Length of time over which rewards sent to this contract are distributed to stakers.

REWARD_TOKEN().notice: ERC20 token in which rewards are denominated and distributed.

SCALE_FACTOR().notice: Scale factor used in reward calculation math to reduce rounding errors caused by truncation during division.

STAKE_TOKEN().notice: Delegable governance token which users stake to earn rewards.

admin().notice: Permissioned actor that can enable/disable `rewardNotifier` addresses, set the max bump tip, set the claim fee parameters, and update the earning power calculator.

alterClaimer(uint256,address).notice: For an existing deposit, change the claimer account which has the right to withdraw staking rewards.

alterDelegatee(uint256,address).notice: For an existing deposit, change the address to which governance voting power is assigned.

bumpEarningPower(uint256,address,uint256.notice: A function that a bumper can call to update a deposit's earning power when a qualifying change in the earning power is returned by the earning power calculator. A deposit's earning power may change as determined by the algorithm of the current earning power calculator. In order to incentivize bumpers to trigger these updates a portion of deposit's unclaimed rewards are sent to the bumper.

claimFeeParameters().notice: Current configuration parameters for the fee assessed on claiming.

claimReward(uint256).notice: Claim reward tokens earned by a given deposit. Message sender must be the claimer address of the deposit or the owner of the deposit. Tokens are sent to the caller.

depositorTotalEarningPower(address).notice: Tracks the total earning power by a depositor across all unique deposits.

depositorTotalStaked(address).notice: Tracks the total staked by a depositor across all unique deposits.

deposits(uint256).notice: Stores the metadata associated with a given deposit.

earningPowerCalculator().notice: Contract that determines a deposit's earning power based on their delegatee.

getDepositInfo(uint256).notice: Returns all useful deposit data for a single deposit in one call.

getDepositorFullSummary(address,uint256[.notice: Returns aggregated staking totals plus total unclaimed rewards for a depositor in one call. Deposit IDs must be supplied by the caller (sourced from the Goldsky indexer via StakeDeposited events filtered on the indexed owner field).

getDepositorSummary(address).notice: Returns aggregated staking totals for a single depositor address.

getDepositsInfo(uint256[]).notice: Batch version of getDepositInfo. Caller supplies deposit IDs sourced from the off-chain indexer (Goldsky). Returns parallel arrays.

getGlobalState().notice: Returns all global state the frontend dashboard needs in one call.

getVotes(address).notice: Returns voting power as staking totals for a depositor

isRewardNotifier(address).notice: Maps addresses to whether they are authorized to call `notifyRewardAmount`.

lastCheckpointTime().notice: Last time at which the global rewards accumulator was updated.

lastTimeRewardDistributed().notice: Timestamp representing the last time at which rewards have been distributed, which is either the current timestamp (because rewards are still actively being streamed) or the time at which the reward duration ended (because all rewards to date have already been streamed).

maxBumpTip().notice: Maximum tip a bumper can request.

notifyRewardAmount(uint256).notice: distributed, creating a shortfall for those claiming their rewards after others. It is    required that a notifier contract always transfers the `_amount` to this contract before    calling this method.

permitAndStake(uint256,address,address,u.notice: Method to stake tokens to a new deposit. Before the staking operation occurs, a signature is passed to the token contract's permit method to spend the would-be staked amount of the token.

permitAndStakeMore(uint256,uint256,uint2.notice: Add more staking tokens to an existing deposit. A staker should call this method when they have an existing deposit, and wish to stake more while retaining the same delegatee and claimer. Before the staking operation occurs, a signature is passed to the token contract's permit method to spend the would-be staked amount of the token.

rewardEndTime().notice: Time at which rewards distribution will complete if there are no new rewards.

rewardPerTokenAccumulated().notice: Live value of the global reward per token accumulator. It is the sum of the last checkpoint value with the live calculation of the value that has accumulated in the interim. This number should monotonically increase over time as more rewards are distributed.

rewardPerTokenAccumulatedCheckpoint().notice: Checkpoint value of the global reward per token accumulator.

scaledRewardRate().notice: Global rate at which rewards are currently being distributed to stakers, denominated in scaled reward tokens per second, using the SCALE_FACTOR.

setClaimFeeParameters((uint96,address)).notice: Updates the parameters related to the claim fee.

setEarningPowerCalculator(address).notice: Set the earning power calculator address.

setRewardNotifier(address,bool).notice: Enables or disables a reward notifier address.

stake(uint256,address).notice: Stake tokens to a new deposit. The caller must pre-approve the staking contract to spend at least the would-be staked amount of the token.

stake(uint256,address,address).notice: Method to stake tokens to a new deposit. The caller must pre-approve the staking contract to spend at least the would-be staked amount of the token.

stakeMore(uint256,uint256).notice: Add more staking tokens to an existing deposit. A staker should call this method when they have an existing deposit, and wish to stake more while retaining the same delegatee and claimer.

surrogates(address).notice: A method to get the delegation surrogate contract for a given delegate.

totalEarningPower().notice: Global amount of earning power for all deposits.

totalStaked().notice: Global amount currently staked across all deposits.

unclaimedReward(uint256).notice: Live value of the unclaimed rewards earned by a given deposit. It is the sum of the last checkpoint value of the unclaimed rewards with the live calculation of the rewards that have accumulated for this account in the interim. This value can only increase, until it is reset to zero once the unearned rewards are claimed. Note that the contract tracks the unclaimed rewards internally with the scale factor included, in order to avoid the accrual of precision losses as users takes actions that cause rewards to be checkpointed. This external helper method is useful for integrations, and returns the value after it has been scaled down to the reward token's raw decimal amount.

withdraw(uint256,uint256).notice: Withdraw staked tokens from an existing deposit.
